asset_context.description: Multi-site prospective natural history protocol for STXBP1-RD (STARR) and SYNGAP1-RD (ProMMiS): clinician-administered developmental measures, caregiver-reported measures, seizure-history reconstruction and quantitative EEG, with CHOP as prime site and data coordinating centre.
asset_context.documented_context: Studied in STXBP1-RD and SYNGAP1-RD cohorts only. The authors state an aim to generalize the framework to other DEEs; that extension is not demonstrated in this paper.
unverified: fit for other diseases or age ranges
asset_context.owner_status: Study team documented (CHOP-led consortium). Ownership of protocol materials not established.
asset_context.proposed_use: A patient organization planning a natural history study reviews which framework components could inform its own protocol.
asset_context.access_status: Published description only. Permission to adopt the protocol, its instrument licences and staff/equipment needs are not checked.

review_summary.note: 'source_checked' means a person checked a narrow factual assertion against the cited source. It is not clinical validation or permission to reuse an asset.
